title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect of LASSO on Bias
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, it tends to increase the bias of the model because it simplifies the model by reducing the number of features.

title: Effect of LASSO on Variance
text: LASSO regularization reduces the variance of the model by simplifying it, which can lead to more stable predictions on new data.

title: Effect of LASSO on MSE
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) on training data might increase due to the added bias, but the MSE on test data might decrease due to reduced variance and overfitting.
